_meta.game: Zeliard, MS-DOS English (Sierra 1990). Japanese-version differences: japanese_balance.json.
_meta.scope: Every regular enemy type, worlds 1-8 (EAI1..EAI8). World 9 (Jashiin's caverns MP90/MPA0) has no regular enemies - only the MAO1/MAO2 boss chunks (bosses.json). Bosses are in bosses.json.
_meta.join_key: For a cavern MDT, byte 3 of its descriptor (eai_bin_idx) selects the AI chunk: 0=EAI1, 2=EAI2, 4=EAI3, 6=EAI4, 8=EAI5, 10=EAI6, 12=EAI7, 14=EAI8 (odd indices and 16-18 are boss chunks). Within that chunk, each MDT monster record's byte +4 low nibble (== byte +14) is the type_id used below. Records whose byte +4 has bit 4 set (0x10..0x1F after masking with 0x1F, e.g. 0x73 chest, 0x76 key, 0x7C sign, 0xD0 hidden wall item, 0xF1 falling object) are map objects, not enemies - see items.json cavern_objects.
_meta.evidence_note: Values were read from the release binaries 3_Assembly/tasm/bin/zelres3/30xEAIx.bin (loaded at DS:A000 after the 4-byte SAR size header), disassembled with capstone; engine semantics from 3_Assembly/ida/fight.asm. Header tables: DS:A008 XP per type, DS:A010 contact damage per type, word DS:A006 -> drop descriptor pointers. HP is written by each type's AI handler when monster.hp is 0.

part_1_notes.scope: Regular enemies of worlds 1-4 (EAI1..EAI4). Boss chunks are separate.

units.frame: One main-loop iteration = one monsters_updates call. Length = speed_const*4 PIT ticks at 236.70 Hz; default speed_const 5 (F9 digit 5) = 20 ticks = 84.5 ms (11.83 frames/s). F9 digit d gives speed_const = 10-d.
units.tile: Map cell. Normal enemies occupy a 2x2 tile block (Move_Monster_NWE_Depending_On_Whats_Below checks 2 tiles; move_monster_* move 1 tile). 'Big' enemies (state_flags bit 0x10 in the MDT record) are two stacked 2x2 records, even type = upper/controlling record, odd type = lower half.
units.m_x_rel: Monster column inside the 36-column proximity window centred on the hero. The hero is at column 17 (0x11); code treats m_x_rel 16/17 (10h/11h) as 'directly above/below the hero'. m_x_rel < 17 means the monster is left of the hero.
units.rows: Vertical tests compare hero_y_absolute (DS:FF35) with monster.currY (0..63, wraps).

part_1_notes.record_key: type_id = MDT monster record byte +4 (flags) low nibble; byte +14 (type_) holds the same value and is copied into +4 when the record (re)activates. The EAI chunk is chosen by the MDT descriptor byte 3 (eai_bin_idx): 0=EAI1, 2=EAI2, 4=EAI3, 6=EAI4 (odd indices are boss chunks). MDT byte +7 (state_flags): bit 0x10 = big two-record monster, bit 0x20 = persist death to the save flag at bytes +11/+12 (address) and +13 (mask), low nibble = preset drop code (overrides the random drop).

shared_rules.hp_init: monster.hp starts at 0 on (re)activation; the AI handler writes the listed hp the first frame it runs.
shared_rules.being_hit: When ai_flags bit 0x20 is set the handler jumps to Hero_Hits_monster (fight.asm 8908): damage = Get_Stats(source = ai_flags & 1Fh). Source 1 = sword: (sword_base[1,2,4,8,32,127][sword-1] + level/2) * (byte_E4+1), capped 255, doubled (cap 255) for the ground downward thrust (sword_hit_type 2). Sources 2..8 = spells Espada..Guerra: 2,4,8,16,32,64,255 flat. Source 9 = Magia Stone spirit: (level+1)*4 capped 255. Source 0 = crushing platform: level/2+1. hp -= damage; if hp <= 0 the monster dies.
shared_rules.immunity_flag: If monster.flags bit 0x20 is set, place_monster_in_proximity_and_run_ai never converts a hit (ai_flags 0x40) into ai_flags 0x20, so the monster cannot be damaged; flags bit 0x40 also removes it from contact-damage checks (get_monster_in_row_or_above skips al&40h).
shared_rules.xp: On death monster_split_or_die adds XP = byte at DS:A008[type] (per-world table) to hero_xp (saturates at 65535).
shared_rules.drops: On death, if state_flags low nibble is 0 the engine picks code = descriptor[type][RNG & 3] (descriptor list pointer = word DS:A006); with the ground downward thrust (sword_hit_type 2) it always takes descriptor[0]. Drop codes: 0 = nothing, 1 = nothing (record removed), 4 = 1 alma coin, 5 = 10 almas, 8 = red potion (+10 healing units), 9 = blue potion (full heal: +maxHP/8+1 healing units), 11 = 100 almas. The drop falls (move S) and is collected by touching it.
shared_rules.contact_damage: check_hero_contact_damage probes four cells beside the hero (outer-left, inner-left, inner-right, outer-right; standing: the row at hero head+1 and the row below, squatting: lower rows only). Each occupied cell adds DS:A010[type] to an accumulator and applies the running accumulator as a hit (so a monster filling two probe cells deals d then 2d). Hit from the side the hero faces with a shield: dmg = (d>>1) >> ((shield_type+1)>>1) i.e. Clay/Wise d/4, Stone/Honor d/8, Light/Titanium d/16; that reduced value is subtracted from BOTH shield HP (shield breaks at <=0) and hero HP. Hit from behind or no shield: full d to hero HP.
shared_rules.projectiles: 13-byte records added via Add_Projectile (max 32). p_trajectory_dir low 3 bits = direction (0 E,1 NE,2 N,3 NW,4 W,5 SW,6 S,7 SE), bit 0x40 = follow curve table (p_curved_path_data_ptr indexed by step count, first index used is 1, FF ends the shot), bit 0x08 = passes through walls (otherwise destroyed on a non-passable tile). Straight shots end when step count reaches p_max_step_count. One tile per frame. Shield block (fight.asm sub_846F): never blocked if direction is 2 or 6 (vertical), if no shield, while swinging the sword, or on a rope; blocked only when the hero faces the incoming shot; with Clay/Wise/Stone shields (type < Honor) the block also requires the shot to be at the shield's row (projectile_y_vs_hero_row_dispatch). Unblocked shots do p_damage to hero HP directly (no shield reduction).
shared_rules.hazard_death: Handlers that call Check_Monster_Ids_Two_Rows_Below (slot 6030h) kill the monster silently (no XP, no drop) when the tile two rows below is one of the tileset's four 'aggressive ground' tile ids (DS:8020).
shared_rules.respawn: Dead monsters keep their spawn coordinates (bytes +11..+13); monster_activation re-creates them from the spawn point when it lies inside the 36-column proximity window but off the visible screen (window column <3 or >=32, or >=24 rows away vertically) and the 3x3 cells are free. Records with the save-persist bit stay dead once the flag is set.

part_2_notes.about: Regular enemies, worlds 5-8. Verified from release bytes of EAI5..EAI8.BIN (3_Assembly/tasm/bin/zelres3/305EAI5.bin..308EAI8.bin, loaded at DS:A000 after the 4-byte SAR size header) disassembled with capstone (helper scratchpad/w58/zdis.py; listings e5..e8.txt). Addresses below are runtime DS addresses. Engine semantics from ida/fight.asm. The MASM Sourcer comments in 305-308*.asm (which call these 'MEDA/ZELA/...' handlers) are wrong about enemy identity and were not used.

conventions.frame: one main-loop iteration (monsters_updates is called once per frame). Default speed (F9 = 5, speed_const 5) = 20 PIT ticks at 236.70 Hz = 84.5 ms, 11.83 frames/s.
conventions.tiles: all positions in tiles. m_x_rel = column of the monster inside the 36-column proximity window centred on the hero; the hero occupies columns 16-17 (0x10/0x11). 'hero right of monster' in code = m_x_rel <= 0x10 or < 0x11 as stated per enemy.
conventions.facing: monster.ai_flags bit7 = 1 facing right (east), 0 facing left.
conventions.range_check: Most enemies use a helper returning 'hero within N rows vertically (|hero_y - y| < N) AND monster already faces the hero'. Called 'aware(N)' below. If in vertical range but facing away, the helper returns the direction toward the hero, which the AI then usually adopts.
conventions.size: normal enemy = one 16-byte MDT record, 2 tiles wide x 2 tall. 'big' enemy = two consecutive records, type N (top/head) + type N+1 (bottom/body, handler is a bare RET); together 2 wide x 4 tall. Horizontal moves of big enemies test 4 rows of the column ahead.
conventions.gravity: MOVE_S each frame when not supported: falls 1 tile per frame (big enemies test 2 columns under the 4-row body).
conventions.hit_sources: monster.ai_flags low 5 bits set by the attacker; Get_Stats damage: 1 = sword (sword base + level/2, x(oil+1), x2 on downward thrust), 2..8 = spells Espada 2, Saeta 4, Fuego 8, Lanzar 16, Rascar 32, Agua 64, Guerra 255, 9 = Magia Stone (level+1)*4 cap 255, 0 = crushing platform (level/2+1). HP <= damage kills.
conventions.drops: On death monster.state_flags low nibble = drop_codes[RNG & 3] (drop_codes[0] if the killing blow was a downward thrust, sword_hit_type 2). Codes: 0 = nothing, 1 = nothing/removed, 4 = Almas 1, 5 = Almas 10, 8 = red potion, 9 = blue potion, 11 = Almas 100 (fight.asm almas_picked_up: 4->1, 5->10, else 100). XP is awarded on every kill.
conventions.projectiles: 13-byte projectile records copied from templates inside the chunk (ida/dungeon.inc struct: x,y,base_tile,step,max_step,dir,damage,...). dir 0 = east, 4 = west; moves 1 tile per step, removed after max_step steps or on a solid tile. Projectile damage is applied to hero HP directly (not shield HP). Block rule (fight.asm sub_846F): no block if no shield, while swinging, on a rope, or for vertical shots; horizontal shot is blocked (no damage) if the hero faces it and shield >= Honor Shield; with Clay/Wise/Stone shields it is blocked only when it arrives at the shield row (projectile_y_vs_hero_row_dispatch), else full damage.
conventions.contact: contact_damage (EAI byte table at A010) summed over the hero's 4 probe cells per frame; if the hero faces the enemy with a shield: dmg >>= 1 then >>= (shield_type+1)>>1 and that reduced value is taken from BOTH shield HP and hero HP; from behind / no shield: full damage to hero. Flags bit 0x40 on the monster type byte = no contact damage; bit 0x20 = cannot be hit (hits not registered in place_monster_in_proximity_and_run_ai).
conventions.community_damage_scale: Fan-site 'points' are life-bar pixels = damage / 8 (e.g. zombie spit 40 -> '5 points', slime red spit 80 -> '10', kiss 20 -> '3'). Code values are real HP.
conventions.respawn: Killed enemies are marked dead in the in-memory MDT copy; they return when the cavern MDT is reloaded (re-entering the map). Enemies deactivate when more than 35 columns away (HorizDistToHero_35) and re-activate at their spawn point.

_meta.confidence: high for hp/xp/contact damage/drops (direct bytes); medium-high for behaviour specs; names are community names mapped by behaviour+XP (confidence given per entry).

mechanics.damage_to_enemy: Hero_Hits_monster: hp -= Get_Stats(source). source 1 sword = min(255,(sword_base + floor(level/2))*(sabre_oil+1)), doubled (cap 255) on the downward thrust; sources 2..8 spells Espada..Guerra = 2,4,8,16,32,64,255; 9 Magia Stone = min(255,(level+1)*4); 0 crushing platform = floor(level/2)+1. hp <= 0 -> dies (or splits for splitting types).
mechanics.contact_damage_to_hero: Each frame the 4 cells beside the hero's body (2 each side; row choice depends on crouching) are probed; each monster cell found adds that type's A010 damage to an accumulator and applies the accumulated amount. If the hero faces the side the hit comes from and has a shield: dmg = (dmg >> 1) >> ((shield_tier+1) >> 1), i.e. /4 Clay & Wise Man's, /8 Stone & Honor, /16 Light & Titanium; the reduced amount is subtracted from BOTH shield HP and hero HP; shield HP <= 0 destroys the shield ('Shield broken.'). Hit from behind or no shield: full damage to hero HP only. No invincibility frames.
mechanics.projectile_damage_to_hero: projectile.p_damage applied directly to hero HP unless blocked: projectiles travelling straight up/down (dirs 2/6) are never blocked; others are blocked (no damage, sound 0Ah) when a shield is equipped, the hero is not swinging and not on a rope, and faces the projectile; shields below Honor additionally only block projectiles at head/body height matching the crouch state (Honor, Light, Titanium block regardless of height). Blocking does not cost shield HP.
mechanics.community_damage_units: Fan-site 'points' of damage are LIFE-bar pixels = real HP damage / 8 (e.g. spit 40 = '5 points').
mechanics.drops: On death the drop code is the record's preset code (MDT byte +7 low nibble) if non-zero, else descriptor[rng & 3] (descriptor[0] when killed by the downward thrust). Codes: 0 = nothing (record respawns later), 1 = nothing and removed, 4 = 1 alma, 5 = 10 almas, 8 = red potion (+80 HP over 10 frames), 9 = blue potion (full heal), 11 = 100 almas. Drops fall and are collected by touching.
mechanics.xp: Awarded on kill from the A008 table (16-bit XP, saturating at 65535).
mechanics.respawn: Records are re-activated from their spawn coordinates (bytes +11..+13) when they come back into the 36-column proximity window after having been off-screen; killed ordinary enemies therefore come back. Records with state_flags bit 0x20 write a save flag on death and never return (e.g. the Magical Bat).
mechanics.activation: Only records within 35 columns of the proximity window's left edge are processed; each frame every active monster runs its type's AI handler once.

enemies.name: Bat
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (The Caverns): 'Flies towards you from the roof, attacks with claws and goes back up'. IDA eai1.asm labels the type-0 frame pointer 'slug' but the type-0 AI branch is unambiguously the ceiling-diver; frame-label naming is wrong.

defence.notes: No invulnerability. Dies silently on hazard tiles two rows below.

behaviour.summary: Hangs on the ceiling; when the hero passes near it dives at him, flies back up to the ceiling as soon as it has hurt the hero (or hits the floor), rests, repeats.

states.does: Each frame tries move N (stays pressed to ceiling). anim counts down 10h per frame from its rest value (70h after a dive = 7 frames).
states.transition: When anim reaches 0 and the bat is between 6 columns left and 9 columns right of the hero (m_x_rel-17 in 0..9 or 17-m_x_rel in 1..6) -> windup. No vertical test.

states.does: anim++ (mod 8).
states.transition: After 3 frames -> dive.

states.does: One tile per frame. v = (hero_y - currY + 21) & 63. v<18 (hero more than ~3 rows above): move NE/NW toward hero; 18<=v<24 (about level): move E/W toward hero; v>=24 (hero below): move SE/SW toward hero. If blocked diagonally, fall back to horizontal; if horizontal blocked or the bat is at hero column (m_x_rel 16/17), move S. Facing bit (ai_flags 80h) follows the direction moved.
states.transition: As soon as hero_damage_this_frame is set (the hero was hurt by anything this frame) or move S is blocked -> return.

states.does: One tile per frame diagonally up (NE if facing right else NW); when the diagonal is blocked it flips facing and moves N; when N is blocked it sets bit 20h and anim=2.
states.transition: Then counts anim 2->0 (2 frames), sets anim=70h and ai_state=0 (hang).

behaviour.speed: 1 tile/frame while diving and returning (11.8 tiles/s at default speed).
behaviour.notes: bat_step_throttle only cycles the animation counter; it does not gate movement.

evidence: ida/eai1.asm Monster_AI flags00 + ai_state_00..c0 (A268..A3D3), hp=2 at A276
301EAI1.bin header A008 xp=3, A010 dmg=5, descriptor[0]=5,4,4,0 (pointer A240)
ida/fight.asm Hero_Hits_monster 8908, monster_split_or_die 8733, drop handler flag_14_15_1b 7357
enemies.conflicts: Fan site gives damage '1 point' (HUD bar units); code contact damage is 5 HP.

enemies.name: Snail/Slug
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page; MdtViewer constants label type 0x01 'Snail/Slug'.

defence.notes: No invulnerability. Dies silently on hazard tiles.

behaviour.summary: Crawls slowly along the floor toward the hero's column.

states.does: Every frame move S first; while it can fall it does nothing else.
states.transition: Landed -> crawl.

states.does: anim = (anim + 41h) & C3h; only when the high bits are 0 (every 4th frame) it moves one tile: E if m_x_rel < 17 (hero to the right) else W. Facing bit set to the direction moved.
states.transition: None; no vertical check, it always homes on the hero column.

evidence: ida/eai1.asm flags01 A3E8..A43E, hp=2 at A3F3
enemies.conflicts: IDA frame labels call this frame group 'bat'; AI code is the crawler.

enemies.name: Frog
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page; MdtViewer labels type 0x02 'Frog'.

behaviour.summary: Hops in short arcs; hops every frame toward the hero when the hero is within 8 rows and in front of it, otherwise once every 8 frames.

states.does: anim = (anim+21h)&E1h each frame; move S (gravity). Test: hero within 8 rows vertically AND frog already facing the hero -> hop now. Otherwise only when anim's top 3 bits are 0 (every 8 frames): if hero within 8 rows turn to face him, then hop.
states.transition: -> hop (ai_state bit 08h, anim=2).

states.does: 4 steps, one per frame, directions NE,E,E,SE when facing right (NW,W,W,SW facing left) (tables jump_angles_right/left).
states.transition: If a step is blocked: reverse facing unless the hero is in front within 8 rows; hop ends. After 4 steps or a block: clear hop, anim=0, move S (falls under gravity afterwards).

behaviour.speed: Hop covers 3 tiles horizontally in 4 frames.

evidence: ida/eai1.asm flags10 A440..A4E5 and frog_hero_proximity_and_direction A4E9 (8-row test), jump_angles_right/left

enemies.name: Rat
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page ('advances rapidly and can jump over small obstacles').

behaviour.summary: Runs along the floor at 1 tile/frame, turns toward the hero when he is within 6 rows, hops small gaps, makes a tall jump over walls, and pauses occasionally before choosing a random direction.

states.does: Move S first (gravity). Each frame: if the tile 2 rows below, one column ahead (proximity offset 48h/49h) is passable (gap ahead) -> gap hop. Else anim cycles 0..3; if not already chasing (ai_state bit 02h) ai_timer += 10h and on overflow (16 frames) -> pause. If hero within 6 rows vertically: face him, mark chasing, reset timer. Move 1 tile E/W in facing direction.
states.transition: Blocked horizontally -> wall jump (ai_state 10h).

states.does: 3 steps: NE,E,E (facing right) / NW,W,W using jump_angles table indices 1..3, checking collision first.
states.transition: Blocked -> pause state; afterwards anim=3, move S.

states.does: Up to 8 steps N,NE,NE,E,E,SE,SE,S (right) / N,NW,NW,W,W,SW,SW,S (left) (rat_jump_angles), index advanced by ai_state += 20h, one step per frame.
states.transition: Blocked -> pause; ends with anim=3, move S.

states.does: Stands; anim alternates 4/5 every 4 frames (anim += 40h). If the hero comes within 6 rows it faces him and resumes running (chasing).
states.transition: After 4 such steps (ai_state += 40h overflow, ~16 frames) picks a random facing (RNG bit 7) and immediately flips it if that side is blocked, then runs.

evidence: ida/eai1.asm flags11 A518..A6EB, rat_hero_proximity_and_direction A6ED (6-row test), rat_jump_angles tables
enemies.conflicts: Fan site says 'Value 1 or 10'; code: 10 almas 25% (always with downward thrust) or nothing.

enemies.name: Alligator Man / Woodcutter / Axe Man
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (Deeper Caverns, 'Runs back while throwing axes'). XP 10 and guaranteed 10-alma drop match.

projectiles.name: thrown axe (normal)
projectiles.template: A4FD facing right / A50A facing left: tile 9Ah, dir 40h (curved), max FFh
projectiles.trajectory: Curve A531 (right): 01 01 01 00 00 07 07 07 07 07 07 FF -> NE,NE,E,E,SE x6 (index 0 unused). Left A53D: 03 03 03 04 04 05 05 05 05 05 05 FF. One tile per frame; destroyed on walls.
projectiles.spawn: column m_x_rel+1 (right) or m_x_rel (left), row currY+2 (lower half)
projectiles.fired_when: Throw state frame anim==6 (2 frames after the throw starts).

projectiles.name: thrown axe (cornered)
projectiles.template: A517 right (dir 0) / A524 left (dir 4), tile 9Ah, max 7 steps
projectiles.fired_when: Used when the throw was triggered because the retreat was blocked (ai_state bit 02h).

defence.notes: Big two-record monster: this (type 0) record controls a 2-wide x 4-tall body; type 1 is its lower half. A hit on either half damages this record (it copies the partner's hit flag at [si+15h]). No invulnerability.

behaviour.summary: Patrols; when the hero is within 5 rows it keeps a preferred distance (7-10 tiles), backing away if the hero comes closer, and throws axes.

states.does: Custom 2x4 fall (A653): moves both records S unless at window column 0 or 35.
If the hero is within 5 rows but behind it, turn round. Every 2 frames (anim += 80h carry) step 1 tile in the facing direction using its own 2x4 collision (A549 east / A5CE west, needs 4 free rows).
states.transition: Blocked -> reverse facing. Hero within 5 rows and in front -> keep-distance.

states.does: Faces the hero. dist = |17 - m_x_rel|. Preferred distance D starts at 8 (separate values for hero-right A6D6 and hero-left A6D7). dist > D: step toward hero (1 tile/frame). dist < D: step away (runs backward). dist == D or approach blocked: re-roll D (right: 7..10, left: 7..10 from RNG) and start a throw.
states.transition: Retreat blocked: 50% nothing this frame, 50% start a 'cornered' throw (straight axe).

states.does: anim=4, anim++ per frame; at anim 6 spawns the axe; at anim 8 ends (anim=0).
states.transition: Back to keep-distance/patrol; 4 frames per throw.

behaviour.notes: The type-0 record gets XP/drop; the lower record (type 1) has its own XP 10 and 10-alma descriptor in the tables but is killed together with the upper one.

evidence: 302EAI2.bin A384..A6D5 (disassembled with capstone): hp=8 at A38A, partner-hit A397, distance tables A6D6/A6D7, Add_Projectile A4F5, templates A4FD/A50A/A517/A524, curves A531/A53D
MP20 records type 0 and 1 carry state_flags 10h (big monster)
enemies.conflicts: Fan site axe damage '3 points' is HUD bars; code damage is 8 (arcing) or 20 (straight).

enemies.name: Alligator Man (lower half)
enemies.name_source: Structural: partner record of type 0.

defence.notes: Its AI entry (A383) is a bare RET; it is moved and animated by the type-0 record. Never place alone.

behaviour.summary: Lower half of the Axe Man; see type 0.

evidence: ida/fight.asm big_type1: odd types are not activated on their own

enemies.name: Blue Slime
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (XP 4, 1 alma, 'basically stays in its place').

defence.notes: No special defence; does not do the hazard check.

behaviour.summary: Sits still, then oozes one tile left or right at random, avoiding ledges.

states.does: Falls (move S) if possible. anim++ mod 8.
states.transition: Every 8 frames -> ooze (ai_state bit 01h, timer 0).

states.does: Animation frames 8..11 driven by ai_timer; at timer 8: RNG sign clear -> if the tile 2 rows below and 2 columns right (offset 4Ah) is solid move E, else move W; RNG sign set -> if the tile 2 below, 1 left (47h) is solid move W else move E.
states.transition: Timer 8..12 more animation, then idle (anim 0). Cycle length 8 + 12 frames.

evidence: 302EAI2.bin A6D8..A7A3: hp=4 at A6DE, random step A730..A782
enemies.conflicts: Fan site: 'won't do you any damage at all' / '1 point'; code contact damage 8.

enemies.name: Toad
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (XP 10, spits, hops toward you).

projectiles.name: spit
projectiles.template: A8D2 right (dir 0) / A8DF left (dir 4), tile 9Eh, max 6 steps
projectiles.trajectory: Straight horizontal, 6 tiles, 1 tile/frame, destroyed on walls.
projectiles.spawn: column m_x_rel+1 (right) or m_x_rel (left), row currY+1

behaviour.summary: Frog-like hopper that also stops to spit horizontally.

states.does: anim=(anim+21h)&E1h; falls. If hero within 5 rows and in front: every frame choose randomly (RNG bit 0): spit or hop. Else only every 8 frames: if the hero is within 5 rows but behind, turn and hop; if hero not within 5 rows, random spit/hop.
states.transition: -> hop or spit.

states.does: 4 steps NE,E,E,SE / NW,W,W,SW (tables A8EC/A8F0), 1 per frame.
states.transition: Blocked: reverse unless the hero is in front; then fall.

states.does: ai_timer 0..4 with anim toggling; at 4 fires spit, anim=7.
states.transition: -> cooldown (bit 02h): 6 frames, then ground.

behaviour.notes: Crouching avoids the spit only if the spit row passes over the crouched hero (projectile row = currY+1).

evidence: 302EAI2.bin A7A4..A922: hp=2 at A7B6, range test A8F4 (5 rows), spit A871..A8BB, template A8D2/A8DF
enemies.conflicts: Fan site spit '3 points' (bars); code 20 HP.

enemies.name: Danger Bat
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (XP 4, 'same as normal bat, double damage').

behaviour.summary: Identical state machine to the World 1 Bat (hang / 3-frame windup / dive / return / 7-frame rest), code A944..AA9F. See world 1 type 0.
behaviour.notes: Only hp (3) and table values differ from the World 1 bat.

evidence: 302EAI2.bin A923..AA9F (byte-for-byte same logic as eai1 flags00), hp=3 at A935

enemies.name: Magical Bat
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (XP 255, appears when you open a chest, only one in the game).

defence.notes: Not placed as a monster record: the MP20 chest at x=47h,y=22h has MDT byte +9 = 05 and state_flags 29h; opening it (fight.asm flag_13 chest branch, anim low nibble 0) turns the chest record into monster type 5 with preset drop code 9 and the save-persist bit (flag byte 0Ah mask 80h), so it never returns once killed.

behaviour.summary: Same bat AI as type 4 (shared handler A923).

evidence: 302EAI2 dispatch A377: types 4 and 5 both -> A923
enemies.conflicts: Community reference lists 'Almas 100 (Almas C)' for this bat; code drop is a blue potion (code 9). The chest note in ida/common.inc ('Chest, Blue Potion (With the One-time Bat)') agrees with the code.

enemies.name: Bush Creature
enemies.name_source: Fan site Enemies page (XP 20, 'walking upside-down on ceilings'). Identified by the ceiling-walking AI.

defence.notes: No invulnerability flag; it is simply out of reach while on the ceiling.

behaviour.summary: Walks along the ceiling; drops down near the hero (or when the ceiling ends / it hits a wall a second time), hops and walks a little on the floor, then climbs diagonally back to the ceiling.

states.does: Every 2 frames (anim bit 0) step 1 tile W/E along the ceiling. Needs collision above (check N); if nothing above -> drop.

Six frames later (anim low bits reach 6) the child is placed 2 tiles beside the parent (to the right if facing right, needs a free 3x3 area; else left), with the parent's type, facing away, and becomes an ordinary green slime (hp 16 when it first runs). If no space the split waits; if no free record, no split.

See defence; movement continues.
